indra: quick heads-up — onboarding paperwing-22b-int3 shows RoPE misalignment when crossing ~40k tokens; micro-harness attached. :eyes:

sam: which kernel/quant flags were you using? any env diffs vs hosted?

indra: private/dedicated (A100) with trt-fastpath, quant=opt-qp-v0.9-int3. run command: `./eval --model=paperwing-22b-int3 --ctx=45000 --kv=private --repeat=3 --kv-debug=rotable,idx`

maria: can you paste a short log snippet and the artifact location?

indra: excerpt from logs:
```
[2026-03-24T05:12:01Z] rotable_idx=40000 freq_ptr=160000 -> ok
[2026-03-24T05:12:02Z] rotable_idx=40001 freq_ptr=160001 -> ok
[2026-03-24T05:12:03Z] rotable_idx=-1 freq_ptr=-9223372036854775808 -> SENTINEL: signed underflow
[2026-03-24T05:12:03Z] gen: "...the night ended" -> "...the night ended the night ended"  <-- repeated fragment with phase shift
```
Full artifacts: s3://redwood-qa/triage/1732109999/paperwing22b_int3.zip

theo: -1 / INT64_MIN sentinel implies a signed underflow somewhere in rotable index arithmetic or cast. interesting that it only hits on trt-fastpath. Did you try forcing uint64 indices?

indra: yes, debug build with `--kv-index-type=uint64` eliminated the sentinel and the repeats. cpu kernel also did not reproduce.

sam: ok triage plan: 1) @theo open BUG-ML-5010 (paperwing-int3-rope-signed-underflow) and assign to eng-runtime; 2) add an assert in rotable accessor in debug builds to crash early if idx < 0; 3) bisect recent PRs touching quant packer / trt kernels for signedness changes; 4) add a long-doc regression harness to CI that appends an 8-token anchor across 40k boundary.

ci-bot: CI:long-onboard/1732109999 queued. matrix: kernels=[trt-fastpath,cpu], quants=[int3,int8], ctxs=[45000,45001,65536]. results and artifacts will be posted to https://ci.redwood.ai/long-onboard/1732109999

maria: also try running with `--pack-stride-check=on --alloc-sanitizer=on` to catch any intermediate overflow in packer math.

indra: uploaded micro-harness and kv dumps to s3://redwood-qa/triage/1732109999/micro_harness.tar.gz. i'll run the bisect with `--kv-index-type=uint64` as a control and report back.

theo: i'll prepare the regression test and add the temporary CI gate for quant packer PRs. thanks for the clear repro, @indra. :thumbsup:
